[TEST DATA — provisioned fixture for the database under test]
Whenever the application database is initialised — the default instance/flaskr.sqlite before every test, the harness `app` fixture, or any database a test itself initialises with init_db() / `flask init-db` — it contains exactly these rows (ids as shown). Passwords are stored hashed; the `password` values shown here are the PLAIN-TEXT credentials that log these users in via POST /auth/login.
